concept: A single sleek humanoid robot mid-stride in a dark void, with a luminous green ascending line arcing dramatically behind it like a soaring market chart — the robot is the physical-AI focal point, the glowing green line is the +629% IPO gold rush, and the mid-stride posture is the 'agents that move now' thesis. Cinematic, bold, scroll-stopping — image carries the message because there is no overlay.
concept_rationale: Visualizes three threads of the tweet in one frame: (1) the humanoid robot = the physical-AI paradigm shift the post is arguing for, (2) the luminous green ascending line behind it = the +629% IPO pump / gold rush the numbers describe, and (3) the mid-stride posture = the 'the agents that move now' call to action. The deep-black void and cool-blue rim light hit Twitter's on-platform bold-mood default; 16:9 is correct because the image, not a caption, must carry the message. Single decisive subject, no clutter, no stock-photo cliché (no handshake, no office, no laptop).
